'''Written Krish''' was the [[Writing/Legends|written form]] of the [[Krish (language)|Krish]] [[Language/Legends|language]], spoken by the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Sanza]]. Confusingly, the script was cobbled together from multiple alphabets, which were used to create words with as few syllables as possible.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==Behind the scenes==
Written Krish was mentioned in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
